name: EzzyJohn App-Style Mobile Navigation
author: ezzyjohn

sections.description:
EzzyJohn App-Style Mobile Navigation adds a clean, app-style bottom navigation menu to your WordPress website on mobile devices.

It is useful for Progressive Web Apps (PWAs), booking platforms, service marketplaces, WooCommerce stores, directories, membership websites, and mobile-first WordPress websites.

After activation, click the Settings link beside the plugin name or go to Settings > EzzyJohn App-Style Mobile Navigation to configure your menu items, icons, links, and design options.

Features

  • Mobile-only bottom navigation menu
  • App-style bottom navigation experience
  • Active menu highlighting
  • Font Awesome icon support
  • Custom PNG/SVG image icon URL support
  • Custom links for every menu item
  • Optional center highlighted button
  • Optional labels
  • Color controls
  • PWA-friendly layout
  • Responsive design
  • Works with Blocksy and most WordPress themes

Support Development

EzzyJohn App-Style Mobile Navigation is provided free to the WordPress community.

If this plugin helps your website and you would like to support future development, you can support the developer through Buy Me a Coffee:

https://buymeacoffee.com/ezzyjohn

Thank you for helping keep this plugin free and actively maintained.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ezzyjohn-app-style-mobile-navigation/ directory, or install the plugin ZIP through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Click the Settings link beside the plugin name, or go to Settings > EzzyJohn App-Style Mobile Navigation.
  4. Configure your menu items, icons, and links.
  5. Visit your website on a mobile device to view the bottom navigation menu.
sections.faq:
Where can I find the settings?

Go to Settings > EzzyJohn App-Style Mobile Navigation. You can also click the Settings link from the Plugins page.

Will this show on desktop?

No. The menu is designed for mobile devices and is hidden on desktop by default.

Can I use my own icons?

Yes. You can use Font Awesome icons or add a custom image icon URL from the WordPress Media Library.

Does it work with PWA websites?

Yes. The plugin is designed to help WordPress websites feel more like a mobile app when used as a Progressive Web App (PWA).

Does it work with Blocksy?

Yes. The plugin works with Blocksy and has also been tested with other WordPress themes.
